request.style: English, warm male solo voice with a rich choral background, acoustic guitar, cello, piano, flute, gentle timpani, reverent and hopeful mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
My heart was filled with bitter pain
My inmost being felt the stain
I was senseless and blind of sight
A brute beast in the cold of night

[Chorus]
Yet I am always with you
You hold me by my right hand
You guide me with your counsel true
And lift me up when I am undone

[Verse]
Afterward you will take me
Into the glory you decree
Whom have I in heaven but you?
With you my soul has nothing due

[Chorus]
Yet I am always with you
You hold me by my right hand
You guide me with your counsel true
And lift me up when I am undone

[Bridge]
My flesh and my heart may fail
But you are the rock of my soul
My portion forever and my goal

[Outro]
I am always with you
You hold me by my right hand
